title: Iznik potters reinterpret floral designs
summary: An Iznik stonepaste dish sets white floral motifs against a blue ground, combining Chinese-derived design elements with Ottoman floral forms.

citations.locator: Object 17.120.19; Date, Geography and opening description
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: An Iznik stonepaste dish sets white floral motifs against a blue ground, combining Chinese-derived design elements with Ottoman floral forms.
The Met dates this dish to about 1560; the year is approximate and does not identify a documented firing date.
Its tulips and flowering branches exemplify the reinterpretation of imported motifs in Ottoman ceramic workshops rather than simple copying of a Chinese model.

review.corroboration: The Met catalogue’s date and design discussion were inspected. A Courtauld result concerned another dish and was not used to date this object.
